therapy.en: Now, this social media trend is called rejection therapy, but it's not a proper form of therapy.
therapy.zh: 虽然这种社交媒体潮流被称为“拒绝疗法”，但它并不是一种正式的治疗手段。

theory.en: There is nothing that can melt down . That's a large part of why people are so excited about fusion: in theory, it offers something close to nuclear power's upside, of abundant , low-carbon electricity, without its biggest danger.
theory.zh: 没有任何东西会熔毁。这正是人们对聚变如此兴奋的重要原因：理论上，它既具备核能的大部分优势，能提供丰富、低碳的电力，又没有核能最大的危险。

thought.en: As always, I would love to know what you thought of this episode.
thought.zh: 一如既往，我很想知道大家对本期节目的看法。

thought.en: They would go back to that market every week or almost every week to buy the same pies because they thought they were so tasty.
thought.zh: 后来他们几乎每周都会回那个市场买同样的派，因为他们觉得太好吃了。

threaten.en: Britain depended on imported food at the time, but German submarines threatened all the ships crossing the Atlantic.
threaten.zh: 当时英国依赖进口食物，但德国潜艇威胁了所有穿过大西洋的船只。
